gpt-4.basis: MoE architecture (~1.8T total, ~220B active per token). Energy scaled for active parameters only.

gpt-4-turbo.basis: Jegham et al. (2025) measured via API observation. Short/medium cost nearly equal — GPT-4 Turbo lacks efficiency gains of newer architectures. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4o.basis: Jegham et al. (2025) 'How Hungry is AI?' - Hardware measurements in commercial datacenters. Non-linear model: short (<1k tokens), medium (1k-5k), long (>5k). IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4.1.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4.1-mini.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 0.847 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4.1-nano.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 0.271 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. Most energy-efficient model in benchmark. Medium values match previous flat entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4.5.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Very high — comparable to o3. Not a typo. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gpt-4o-mini.basis: Estimated. Was incorrectly aliased to gpt-4o in prior versions. Smaller MoE, similar scale to gpt-4.1-mini. No Jegham measurement. Tier 3 ±1000% until direct benchmark available.

gpt-3.5-turbo.basis: Dense architecture (~20B), optimized batching. Active = total for dense models.

o1.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 12.1 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. Reasoning model with extended chain-of-thought. Medium values match previous flat entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

o1-mini.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Lightweight reasoning model. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

o3.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 21.414 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. Advanced reasoning model. 79x more energy than GPT-4.1 nano. Medium values match previous flat entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

o3-mini.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

o4-mini.basis: Jegham et al. (2025) medium reasoning effort (API default). High-effort figures are ~3x higher. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

claude-3-opus.basis: Dense ~175B parameter model. Full parameter activation per token.

claude-3-haiku.basis: Dense ~20B parameter model, optimized for speed.

claude-3.5-sonnet.basis: Dense ~70B, improved efficiency over Claude 3 Sonnet. No Jegham measurement. Most widely deployed Anthropic model; flagged as priority for Tier upgrade in v0.2.5.

claude-3.5-haiku.basis: Estimated. Claude 3.5 Haiku is faster/smaller than 3.5 Sonnet (~20B). Jegham et al. (2025) listed in infrastructure table but did not publish energy figures. Tier 3 ±1000%.

claude-3.7-sonnet.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 2.781 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. Ranked highest in eco-efficiency among large models. Medium values match previous flat entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

claude-3.7-sonnet-thinking.basis: Jegham et al. (2025) Extended Thinking variant. Auto-detected in v0.2.4 via thinking={type:enabled} kwarg. ~2x more energy than standard claude-3.7-sonnet. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

gemini-1.5-pro.basis: MoE architecture (~500B total, ~100B active per token).

gemini-2.0-flash.basis: Tier 1 - Google Environmental Report (Aug 2025): 0.24 Wh per median Gemini Apps prompt. Reverse-engineered assuming 1600 token median (800 in, 800 out), PUE 1.10, 3:1 output/input ratio. CRITICAL ASSUMPTION: If median prompt is actually shorter (e.g., 400 tokens), these values could be 4x higher. Cloud-optimized (hyperscale batching). Long context (>128k): +40% due to KV-cache memory pressure. See GEMINI_CALIBRATION.md. Source: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/infrastructure/measuring-the-environmental-impact-of-ai-inference/

gemini-2.5-flash.basis: Estimated. No published energy figures or Jegham measurement for Gemini 2.5 Flash. Value proxied from Gemini 2.0 Flash (same order of magnitude). Efficiency direction vs 2.0 Flash is uncertain — increased capability may offset architectural gains. Use VETCH_REGION + live grid data for any carbon commitments. Tier 3 ±1000%.

gemini-2.5-pro.basis: Estimated. No published energy figures or Jegham measurement for Gemini 2.5 Pro. Value proxied from Gemini 1.5 Pro (same frontier MoE tier). Efficiency direction vs 1.5 Pro is uncertain. Tier 3 ±1000%.

llama-3-70b.basis: Dense 70B. Meta published training energy reverse-scaled for inference.

llama-3.1-8b.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

llama-3.1-70b.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Separate from legacy llama-3-70b entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

llama-3.1-405b.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Largest open-weight dense model. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

llama-3.3-70b.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). ~4x more efficient than llama-3.1-70b. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

mixtral-8x7b.basis: MoE with 8 experts, 2 active. 47B total, ~13B active per token.

mixtral-8x22b.basis: MoE with 8 experts, 2 active. 141B total, ~39B active per token.

deepseek-r1.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). Medium: 29.0 Wh for 1k in + 1k out. Most energy-intensive in benchmark. Short is very high — short prompts trigger maximal thinking overhead. Medium values match previous flat entry. IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598

deepseek-v3.basis: Jegham et al. (2025). IT equipment energy only (pre-PUE). Vetch applies PUE separately in calculate_carbon(). Source: arXiv:2505.09598
